description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is an urgent opening for a compassionate leader ready to make a significant impact on patient care and staff development. If you are passionate about delivering high-quality healthcare and fostering a supportive environment, we encourage you to apply.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, and maintaining regulatory compliance. This role offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year, reflecting the critical importance of this leadership position. Join a team committed to excellence and continuous improvement.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 2 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing
Experience within a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and manage a nursing team
